judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a scene set on top of a solid-looking cloudscape that serves as the ground.
Include a hot air balloon with a large envelope featuring vertical red and white stripes and a brown wicker basket.
requirements.note: The envelope's vertical stripes are gold, red and blue - sampled at (150,200) RGB 226,190,76 and (225,200) RGB 39,104,164. There is no white stripe anywhere on the envelope.

requirements.text: The balloon's basket must be resting firmly on the surface of a large, flat-topped cloud.
Show ropes connecting the balloon's envelope to the basket.
Include four human figures styled as a family: two adults and two children.
Position one adult figure holding a corner of a red and white checkered picnic blanket, while one child figure holds the opposite corner, as if they are spreading it out together on the cloud.
requirements.note: The checkered blanket lies flat on the cloud with nobody touching it. No adult and no child holds any corner, so the spreading-it-out pose is absent.

requirements.text: Place an open picnic basket on a corner of the blanket that is already spread out.
requirements.note: The basket sits at the middle of the blanket's left edge - its contact footprint is about 26% across the blanket's width and 62% of the way from the far edge to the near edge, i.e. in a mid-edge cell rather than a corner cell.

requirements.text: A thermos, a bunch of grapes, and a sandwich must be visible emerging from the open picnic basket.
requirements.note: Only a baguette emerges from the picnic basket. The orange bottle, the fruit bowl and the sandwich plate all sit separately on the blanket, and no bunch of grapes is drawn anywhere in the render.

requirements.text: Position the second adult and second child near the landed hot air balloon, with the adult pointing up at the balloon's envelope.
requirements.note: The second adult (the woman) stands in the middle of the scene about 270 px from the balloon with both arms down, and the second child stands further right still. The only adult near the balloon holds a hamper with his arm extended sideways, not pointing up at the envelope.

requirements.text: The background must be a clear blue sky containing a bright yellow sun and two small, distant clouds.
requirements.note: Four small distant clouds are drawn in the sky - at roughly (100,90), (430,155), (640,50) and (890,205) - not two.
